title: Post-fire smoke purge systems in occupancy Group R-2.
officialText: Post-fire smoke purge systems in R-2 occupancies shall comply with either Section 916.3.1 or 916.3.2. Smoke removed must be discharged to a safe location outside the building and shall not be recirculated into the building in accordance with the New York City Mechanical Code.
